libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.name: Security.SSLSetEnabledCiphers
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.note: ctypes call into Apple Security framework (SecureTransport) in bundled urllib3 (B2h); selects cipher suites on the TLS context

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.name: Security.SSLSetALPNProtocols
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.note: configures an existing TLS context (B2c read literally); ALPN itself is not cryptographic, borderline

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.name: Security.SSLSetIOFuncs
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.note: configures the TLS context's I/O (wrapping step); borderline

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.name: Security.SSLSetConnection
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.note: binds the TLS context to the connection (wrapping step); borderline

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.name: Security.SSLSetCertificate
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.note: loads the client certificate chain into the context, like load_cert_chain

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.name: Security.SecCertificateCopyData
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/securetransp.note: serialises the peer certificate to DER; same role as OpenSSL.crypto.dump_certificate in pyopenssl.py

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.name: X509
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.note: OpenSSL.crypto.X509() instantiation (certificate object creation); used only as a feature check

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.name: peer_cert.to_cryptography
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.note: exports a pyOpenSSL certificate to a cryptography certificate object (B2a by analogy)

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.name: self._ctx.set_passwd_cb
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.note: private-key passphrase callback on the TLS context

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.name: self._ctx.set_alpn_protos
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.note: configures an existing TLS context (B2c read literally); ALPN itself is not cryptographic, borderline

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.name: OpenSSL.SSL.Connection
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.note: wraps the socket with the TLS context

libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.name: cnx.set_connect_state
libs/common/urllib3/contrib/pyopenssl.py.note: configures the TLS connection as client side; borderline
